Semiconductor Market Doubling in 2026 – Last Issueby Bill Jewell on 11-18-2026 at 2:00 pm

Categories: Semiconductor Intelligence, Semiconductor Services

Key takeaways ▼

The global semiconductor market was $481 billion in 3rd quarter 2026, according to WSTS. 3Q 2026 was up 27% from 2Q 2026 and up 129% from 3Q 2025. The 3Q 2026 year-to-year growth was the highest in WSTS history, exceeding 110% growth in 2Q 2026 versus 2Q 2025.
AI continued to dominate semiconductor market growth. Nvidia 3Q 2026 revenue was up 20% from 2Q 2026. The memory companies (Samsung Semiconductor, SK Hynix, Micron Technology, Kioxia and Sandisk) all cited AI as their primary growth driver and collectively increased revenue 36% from the prior quarter. The revenue of all the top twenty semiconductor suppliers rose in 3Q 2026 from 2Q 2026. The highest growth was from memory companies SK Hynix at 49% and Kioxia at 40%.

The revenue guidance for 4Q 2026 versus 3Q 2026 is mixed. Of the fourteen companies providing guidance, ten expect a gain in revenue while four expect a decline. The strongest growth expectations are from AMD at 27% (citing data center demand) and MediaTek at 29% (due to AI accelerator demand). Nvidia guided for quarter-to-quarter revenue advancement moderating from 20% in 3Q 2026 to 12% in 4Q 2026.
Intel guided for a 6.1% revenue drop in 4Q 2026 because of a weak PC market. Skyworks expects a 6.7% decline due to a weak smartphone market. Skyworks is a new entry to the top twenty after completing its merger with Qorvo. As a result, Onsemi dropped out of the top twenty. Texas Instruments and Infineon Technologies both guided for 4Q 2026 revenue declines of 0.1% and 2.3%, respectively. However, both companies cited these decreases as above typical 4th quarter seasonality.
In the first three quarters of 2026, the semiconductor market is up 104% from the first three quarters of 2025. The full year 2026 semiconductor market is certain to be at least double year 2025. This extraordinary growth has not been seen since the early days of the industry over sixty years ago. Recent forecasts for 2026 are in a narrow range of 110% to 112%. Forecasts for 2027 vary widely, from RCD Advisors’ 23% to our Semiconductor Intelligence’s 60%. We believe quarter-to-quarter growth rates will slow down in 2027, but momentum will drive significant growth. Our base case is a 60% increase in 2027. However, our high-end scenario is an 80% increase.

Last Issue
This is the last newsletter from Semiconductor Intelligence, as I begin full-time retirement. I have enjoyed providing these newsletters over the last seventeen years. I hope they have been informative.
